prompt:
The section file sections/featured-product-highlights.liquid has working markup but its {% schema %} block is out of date. The markup reads section.settings.product (a product, may be blank), section.settings.highlight_limit (number used as the `limit:` of the block loop) and, for each block, block.settings.label (text) and block.settings.hide (boolean). Blocks with hide set to true are skipped. Leave the markup exactly as it is and replace only the JSON inside the single {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block with this exact schema, keeping the keys in this order.

Top level:
- "name": "Featured product"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "featured-product-section"
- "settings": two settings, in this order:
  1. type "product", id "product", label "Product" (no default)
  2. type "range", id "highlight_limit", label "Highlights to show", min 1, max 8, step 1, default 4. All four numbers must be JSON numbers.
- "blocks": exactly one block type: type "highlight", name "Highlight", with two settings in this order:
  1. type "text", id "label", label "Label", default "Free shipping"
  2. type "checkbox", id "hide", label "Hide highlight", default false (a JSON boolean)
- "max_blocks": 8, a number.
- "presets": one preset with name "Featured product" and blocks containing two entries, each {"type": "highlight"}.

No other keys are allowed anywhere in the schema. Change only sections/featured-product-highlights.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
